description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for the "git checkout-index --temp" functionality. It sets up a test environment, performs various checkout operations with different options, and verifies the correctness of the outputs. The script uses commands like "git read-tree", "git update-index", and "git checkout-index" to manipulate and test the Git index and working directory states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution. It runs a set of commands and validates expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a given output or file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Confirms that a given command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for patterns in output or files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a given output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or strings.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific path is missing in the filesystem.
